draft.headline: Auth as one line of config
draft.body:
What if you could ship every release without last-minute fires?

We just shipped an API change that turns auth from a bottleneck into one line of config. Here's what changed and why it matters.

• What changed: a single endpoint, same security, less code.
• How it reduces rework: no more custom middleware for every service.
• Where to try it: docs and a sandbox are live.

Try it free →
